title: SNAP: June 2025 actual recipients
description: The complete monthly PAMS issuance-office cohort, including combined offices, unassigned recipients and statewide total.
geography: Ohio issuance offices and statewide total
methodology: Recipients received a benefit in the reporting month. The original SNAP definitions say adults are over age 22 and children are under age 22 and living with a parent; retain those definitions without substituting under age 18. Household counts and active-member counts are different units.

source.title: Public Assistance Monthly Statistics: June 2025
source.publisher: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services
source.locator: Seven-page report; final SNAP program detail table
source.note: June 2025 is the selected month, not a reconstructed annual population share.
source.rights: Attributed statistical facts; original publisher rights remain with its source.
